acceptanceCriteria: A1: A newly archived Work Item outcome and embedded Task Outcome report contain only repository-valid archive references for Contract, Summary, and generated report artifacts; no generated human-facing claim points to an active artifact that no longer exists
A2: Archived changedPaths, task-report JSON/Markdown, and event evidenceRefs are normalized only at archive creation, retain their digest bindings, and do not rewrite existing archive bytes
A3: Outcome and human handoff projections for an archived Work Item resolve and display valid archive references while preserving Contract-language text and evidence identity

A4: Regression tests cover normal finish-to-archive output, raw archived outcome/task-report/events, human Outcome projection, archive manifest digests, and an existing historical archive that is not modified
A5: English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese documentation states the active-to-archive projection boundary and the immutable historical archive rule
goal: Ensure archived Outcome and human handoff records reference valid archive artifacts after active files move
intent: Fix generated archive Outcome references that point to removed active artifacts
outOfScope: Modifying global Agent or MCP configuration
sources: reported archive Outcome changedPaths active-path defect
reference outcome-report documentation and existing archive integrity tests
